from pathlib import Path
import re
zones={}
for i in range(1,50):
 c=Path(f'pc{i}/etc/bind/named.conf.lab').read_text(); z=re.search(r'zone \"(["'^"]+)"'"',c).group(1); data=Path(f'pc{i}/etc/bind/db.lab').read_text(); ip=re.search(r'inet ([\\d.]+)/',Path(f'pc{i}.startup').read_text()).group(1); assert f'@ IN A {ip}' in data; zones[z]=(i,ip,data)
assert len(zones)==49
n=0

 if z=='.': continue
 parent=z.split('.',1)[1] if '.' in z else '.'
 pd=zones[parent][2]

 n+=1
